summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares AZD5335 with mirvetuximab soravtansine (FRα-high cohort) or with investigator's choice chemotherapy (FRα-low cohort) in women with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer. AZD5335 and the comparator drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and the dosing schedule and how often they are given are not stated. The main outcome is progression-free survival (PFS), and the study aims to show that AZD5335 is superior to standard care.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara AZD5335 con mirvetuximab soravtansine (cohorte con FRα alta) o con quimioterapia elegida por el investigador (cohorte con FRα baja) en mujeres con cáncer epitelial de ovario, de trompa de Falopio o peritoneal primario resistente al platino. AZD5335 y los medicamentos de comparación se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y el esquema y la frecuencia de dosis no se indican. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión (SLP), y el estudio busca demostrar que AZD5335 es superior al tratamiento estándar.
who_for: Confirmed high-grade serous ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer.
Platinum-resistant disease, with progression within set time limits after the last platinum dose.
Radiological progression on or after the most recent line of therapy.
One to three prior systemic lines, with single-agent therapy suitable as the next treatment.
If BRCA mutated and eligible, prior PARP inhibitor required; FFPE tumour tissue sample must be provided.
not_for: Endometrioid, clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatous, low-grade, or borderline ovarian tumour histology.
Primary platinum-refractory disease, progressing within 3 months of first-line platinum.
History or suspicion of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Prior FRα-targeted therapy or any TOP1 inhibitor antibody drug conjugate.
Current signs or tests suggesting bowel obstruction, including sub-occlusive disease.
